ToolRegistry.register compiles a static inputSchema once so a broken
schema throws at startup naming the tool, and function-valued sources
compile per call cached by schema object identity (WeakMap); execute
reuses the register-time validator instead of recompiling per call.
Rejection text and log lines carry only property paths and the failed
constraint, never values.

Also repairs the CI findings from the last push: the lockfile hoisted
ajv 6 into src resolution (now ajv 8.20.0 is the root entry and ajv
6.15.0 nests under eslint), registry.ts drops the ajv named type import,
the unit test asserts one object instead of three expects, and the
acceptance provider guard is flipped to an early return with its member
chain split.
